about: Budgets for scripts/perf.sh --size. now = measured on the dev box (see docs/architecture/perf-run-2026-11.md); a run passes a metric when it is within tolerance of now. target = where the speed work should get to; why = one line on what makes the target reachable.

metrics.label: cold startup to first row
metrics.why: backend load_state plus headless boot; half of the cold first row is bundle parse and the 10k payload, a slim first-page payload plus streaming the rest gets under 500 ms

metrics.label: cold startup to interactive
metrics.why: interactive should follow first row within one or two frames once boot work after the first paint is idle-scheduled

metrics.label: warm startup to first row
metrics.why: warm backend load_state is about 110 ms at 10k and the warm headless boot about 590 ms; a cached first page and lazy overlays leave room for 300 ms

metrics.label: warm startup to interactive
metrics.why: same as warm first row plus one frame

metrics.label: backend load_state, warm
metrics.why: build_track_infos plus JSON is linear in tracks; a binary or pre-serialised payload halves it

metrics.label: load_state payload
metrics.why: the payload is JSON with base64 row previews; short keys and binary previews cut it in half

metrics.label: track load to first audio (backend)
metrics.path: derived.all.track load to first audio ms
metrics.why: get_analysis_data plus engine load is a few ms already; keep it under one frame

metrics.label: full waveform detail, first time
metrics.why: decode is parallel already, the meter is not; a parallel meter on 8 cores leaves about 100 ms per 6-minute track

metrics.label: full waveform detail, cached
metrics.why: a file read of 1.4 MB; keep it there

metrics.label: expand to detail drawn (frontend)
metrics.why: three frames; the zoom paint is one task now and can be split per frame

metrics.label: analysis throughput (5-7 min tracks)
metrics.why: predict (ONNX beat model) is about 80% of each track at 12 threads; fewer or shorter model chunks and an int8 model are each worth about 1.5x, so about 3x is in reach

metrics.label: time to analyse 10k tracks (extrapolated)
metrics.why: 10,000 divided by the throughput target; extrapolated from the 12-track timed sample, not a full 10k run

metrics.label: analysis first result
metrics.why: one 6-minute track on all cores is about 12 s; a fast first pass (BPM and key before the grid) on the first track shows a result in about 5 s

metrics.label: import of the fixture, end to end (backend)
metrics.why: tag reads are I/O plus lofty on 8 threads and add_tracks is one transaction; cover thumbnails off the commit path gives about 2x

metrics.label: re-import the same folder (all in library)
metrics.why: every file is already known by path; a path and mtime check can skip the tag read entirely

metrics.label: import UI click to rows (frontend)
metrics.path: import.frontend.import ui click to rows ms
metrics.why: rows are appended without a reload already; the remaining cost is the row model for the new tracks

metrics.label: scroll during analysis: frame p95
metrics.why: idle scroll p95 on the headless box is about 27 ms (software paint floor); analysis should not add to it

metrics.label: scroll during analysis: frames dropped
metrics.why: idle scroll drops about 30 on the headless floor; analysis events batched per frame should keep it close

metrics.label: scroll during analysis: long-task total
metrics.why: no task over 50 ms while scrolling; idle scroll already has none

metrics.label: typing during analysis: worst keystroke
metrics.path: ui.during_bulk_analysis.typing + palette during fast pass keyWorst
metrics.why: idle search keystrokes are about 60-90 ms; analysis should not push the worst one past 100

measured: dev box, 16 cores, 2026-10-31, analysis at 12 threads; 25k analysis rows copy the 10k sample (same 12 files, size-independent); 25k startup frontend from a rerun at load 36-50; 25k bulk-analysis UI not measured (timed out at load 60); 50k not measured
